target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of both included PSP remasters on the selected PS3/RPCS3 route

areas.name: Collection and Remaster Setup
areas.location_cue: The PS3 Origins Collection launcher, two-game selector, 1080p output settings, and separate save-data entries.
areas.note: This package remasters Chains of Olympus and Ghost of Sparta and adds no third campaign.

levels.1: Choose the collection route selected in the catalog.
levels.2: Run the PS3 Origins Collection on original hardware or RPCS3.
levels.3: Launch the collection, confirm both remastered PSP titles appear, use separate save slots, and avoid gameplay-altering emulator patches.

levels.1: Confirm the native collection build is active.
levels.2: Check the PS3 or emulator display information.
levels.3: Open either component and verify the Origins Collection build is producing its intended high-resolution presentation and smooth frame-rate target.

levels.1: The two games retain independent clear data.
levels.2: Create labelled backup sets for both included titles.
levels.3: Use distinct save slots and backup folders for Chains of Olympus and Ghost of Sparta, preserving their difficulty, challenge, costume, and bonus states independently.

areas.name: God of War: Chains of Olympus Component
areas.location_cue: The God of War: Chains of Olympus entry in the package selector and its own load, challenge, and bonus menus.
areas.note: All gameplay requirements live in the verified standalone `god-of-war-chains-of-olympus` pack.

items.label: Complete God of War: Chains of Olympus

levels.1: Treat this included title as a complete standalone project.
levels.3: Complete the standalone God of War: Chains of Olympus pack in full, including its campaign clears, finite collectibles, upgrades, difficulty-gated rewards, challenges, secrets, and post-clear menus. Preserve its completed save separately.

items.label: Verify God of War: Chains of Olympus Clear Data

levels.1: Return to the package selector only after its persistent unlocks are saved.
levels.2: Reload the completed component and inspect its post-clear menus.
levels.3: Load the completed God of War: Chains of Olympus data, open every challenge, replay, costume, treasure, arena, or bonus menu used by its standalone pack, exit normally, then reload once to confirm persistence.

areas.name: Final Wrapper Audit
areas.location_cue: The package selector and every included title's load and bonus menus.
areas.note: The wrapper is complete only when every constituent standalone pack remains complete.

levels.1: A final pass catches mixed saves, missing entitlements, or lost clear data.
levels.2: Launch every included title and reload its completed save.
levels.3: Open each component in turn, verify its standalone completion menus and inventory, return cleanly to the package selector, and retain separate backups for every game.
